Pita Pizza
By: Helen Pitlick
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




1 whole wheat pita bread
4 tablespoons spaghetti sauce, or to taste
mozzarella cheese
grated parmesan cheese (optional)
slices of pepperoni
chopped veggies of choice

Preparation

1 Spread spaghetti sauce on the pita bread. Top with veggies or pepperoni. Sprinkle with grated cheeses. Place on baking tray and top brown or broil in toaster oven.

About


If you like crispy crusts, you can toast the pita bread first.
